parameters.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int
parameters.name: timestamp
name
parameters.description: name of the user; length: 1-32; charset: _, 0-9, a-z, A-Z

parameters.name: observer
parameters.description: the default is empty, 1 is forced login, 2 is observer mode login

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: login password; choose one of signature and password. for the security of your account, it is recommended to log in with signature.

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: login signature; rules:SHA-1 encryption of:name+timestamp(int)+SHA-1 encrypted password

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: response code, zero for success, non-zero for errors

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: response message, description for the response code

parameters.name: timestamp_delta
parameters.description: timestamp delta seconds (server datetime - local datetime)

parameters.name: timestamp_error
parameters.description: timestamp error or not, must update the local/chassis system datetime when set to true
